title: Death by Pudding

lines.text: Lord Pumpernickel was found face down in his pudding. Poisoned!
lines.eleven_prompt: [dramatically] Lord Pumpernickel was found... face down in his pudding. [pause] Poisoned!

lines.text: Three suspects. One killer. And one tiny clue that almost everyone misses.
lines.eleven_prompt: Three suspects. One killer. [mischievously] And one tiny clue that almost everyone misses.

lines.text: Phew, what a blizzard! Right. Nobody leaves until I find the poisoner.
lines.eleven_prompt: [exhales] Phew... what a blizzard! [pause] [slowly] Right. Nobody leaves... until I find the poisoner.

lines.text: I made the pudding at six. Then I chopped onions all night. That's why I'm crying!
lines.eleven_prompt: [strong French accent] [crying] I made the pudding at six! Then I chopped onions all night. [sobbing] That's why I'm crying!

lines.text: I was in the library, typing his new will. He left everything to his cat.
lines.eleven_prompt: [haughtily] I was in the library, typing his new will. [pause] He left everything... to his cat.

lines.text: Don't look at me! I only just got here. My car pulled in right before yours, detective.
lines.eleven_prompt: [smugly] Don't look at me! I only just got here. My car pulled in right before yours, detective.

lines.text: Interesting. Let me have a look around.
lines.eleven_prompt: [curious] Interesting. [pause] Let me have a look around.

lines.text: Case closed. The killer already told me everything.
lines.eleven_prompt: [confidently] Case closed. [pause] The killer already told me everything.

lines.text: Gaston was in the kitchen. Miss Prim was in the library. And Cedric had only just arrived.
lines.eleven_prompt: Gaston was in the kitchen. Miss Prim was in the library. And Cedric... had only just arrived.

lines.text: And no, it wasn't the cat. So, who is the killer?
lines.eleven_prompt: [dryly] And no, it wasn't the cat. [pause] So... who is the killer?
